for_terminal_2.headline_for_any_write_up: G0 as AMENDED (AMENDMENT_1.md, 2026-09-20): for the HISTORICAL comparisons on the 2018 development pools, precision is limited NEAR EQUALITY - an adjusted one-sided bound at or below .001 was not achievable for a comparison whose point estimate sat near zero (smallest adjusted half-width 0.00220 nats, medians 0.0069-0.0136; already true unadjusted at one-sided 95 percent, smallest 0.00141). This does NOT rule out passing: the criterion is one-sided, so a sufficiently negative estimate passes at any observed half-width (<= -0.00120 at the smallest), and historical widths do not lower-bound a new mechanism paired-loss SE. The earlier claim that .001 was unconfirmable for ANY mechanism is WITHDRAWN. The .001 margin is unchanged.
narrow_the_contribution_statement: The unconditional nullspace feasibility test is verbatim Rassouli and Gunduz Proposition 1; cite, do not derive.
The delta=0 linear-cost problem already has a published LP in that paper, including MSE and error-probability utilities.
SRLIP quantifies over all attribute-subset views simultaneously under a stronger pointwise metric; a multi-view novelty claim will not survive review.
Calmon et al. is quasiconvex not convex, needs the protected attribute at apply time, and already proposes conditioning on a named sub-view.
Conditional Privacy Funnel is an occupied name (Rodriguez-Galvez et al. ITW 2021; de Freitas and Geiger CPFSI, Machine Learning 2025). Use role-constrained stochastic release.
Xu and Strohmer needs the sensitive attribute at inference to select the transport map; rule it out on the contract, not on directness.
Cite and distinguish Zamani et al. arXiv:2211.15525 and arXiv:2601.04815; the latter preempts heterogeneous per-role budgets.
Defensible: the deployment contract plus the nested local/coalition role structure solved as a convex program with a linear cost.
do_not_claim: No fitted-model conditional-information result is a population certificate. Binning the coalition view drops a full log 2 leak to exactly zero in the validated fixture.

No confirmation at .001 is claimed from a near-equality estimate on this evidence base; a confirmable pass requires a sufficiently negative candidate-specific estimate, with its own paired-household interval reported.
A supervised residence diagnostic can never support a reserved-task transfer claim.

Nothing in this study bears on whether a role-constrained stochastic release beats a deterministic one. The constrained mechanism was never reached because the UNCONSTRAINED release already failed. Do not present G2 as evidence against randomization.
G2 is not a capacity theorem. A different code, probe family or resolution could differ, and the review was explicit that failure of a simple release is an operational warning, not a theorem.
for_terminal_2.established_mathematics_not_contribution: The stochastic-optimization and nullspace results are established mathematics: Rassouli and Gunduz Proposition 1 is the feasibility criterion verbatim, their Theorem 1 gives the delta=0 LP including squared-error and error-probability utilities, convexity follows from joint convexity of relative entropy composed with affine maps, and the privacy funnel nonconvexity diagnosis is Makhdoumi et al. Present them as cited background and as implementation validation. Any PCRL contribution must rest on the adaptation - deployment contract, nested local-vs-coalition roles, the conditional multi-role delta>0 case - and on the empirical evidence.
for_terminal_2.headline_finding: SUBSUMPTION: the release contract already hands out the A-side residence signal that an extension is trying to add. This is a mechanism-level explanation for why this line of work has repeatedly gone negative, and it is NOT the compression-destroys-signal story. It is the second structural issue the review memo raised in its section 1, measured directly.

verdict: Closed negative at gate G2 (capacity), before the stochastic mechanism was constrained. A prespecified label-free A-side code carries genuine residence signal (T alone beats the prior by 0.014-0.022 nats in every anchor) but that signal is ALREADY SUBSUMED by the released service predictions J: adding the code to J does not improve on J and is slightly worse. Seed-mean advantage over same-host J is -0.00268 nats at |T|=64 and -0.01136 at the predeclared |T|=256 fallback, 0 of 3 anchors positive at either resolution, and exactly 0.00000 under the inclusion-respecting accounting. Stages C and D were not run per the gate rule; no grid expanded, no threshold changed.
